body.statement: The query \(\tau_{x,y}\) is uniformly identified on the exact support face, meaning \(\tau_{x,y}(\theta)=\tau_{x,y}(\theta')\) for all \(\theta,\theta'\in\Theta_S\) with \(P_{\theta}=P_{\theta'}\), if and only if \(h_{x,y}|_{T(S)}\in\operatorname{row}_{\mathbb Q}(B)=\bigotimes_{j=1}^m\operatorname{row}_{\mathbb Q}(B_j)\).
body.justification: This is the complete theorem-level kernel: a finite support-only criterion with both formula and failure semantics.
body.gap: The closest papers provide sufficient positivity conditions, invariant cuts, or numerical singleton tests; none gives this support-uniform iff tensor characterization.
body.consumer: It decides whether a deterministic intervention remains learnable under structural zeros without changing the estimand.
